qs.why: Genus capital, species small, italic when printed.

qs.q: Who made binomial nomenclature the standard way to name species?
qs.why: Linnaeus, the father of modern taxonomy (18th century).

qs.q: Which kingdom contains organisms with prokaryotic cells?
A mushroom is placed in kingdom Fungi and not Plantae because it
o: has no chlorophyll and absorbs its food
qs.why: Fungi are heterotrophs that absorb digested food; they have chitin walls.
